# ModelAdaptationMechanism

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A technique for dynamically updating the tracking model's parameters or representations in response to appearance changes of the target object during inference. Critical for in-network neuromorphic systems where static models fail due to environmental variability, enabling real-time plasticity and robustness in edge deployments.
